content.text:
The contact page is fixed. On phones, the long support email address (`[EMAIL]`) couldn't wrap. It pushed the page about 34px wider than the screen. That made the "Other ways to reach us" card overflow and the rest of the page look off.

The fix is in `site/css/pages.css`:
- **Grid column:** `.contact-grid > *` now has `min-width: 0`, so the column can shrink to fit.
- **Contact details:** `.info-list dd` now has `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, so the address wraps instead of overflowing. I also set its left margin to 0.

The two contact visual tests (desktop and phone) were failing before the change. After it, all 28 tests pass, functional and visual. The page now matches the approved screenshots, so I didn't change them.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
